headline: Stolen Financial Records from Tanaka Seimitsu Kogyo Co., Ltd. Leaked Online
body: In a follow-up to the recent ransomware attack, Tanaka Seimitsu Kogyo Co., Ltd. has reported that the attackers have leaked stolen financial records online. The breach, which led to a partial operational shutdown, also affected the company's ability to fulfill orders. Tanaka Seimitsu Kogyo Co., Ltd. continues to collaborate with cybersecurity experts to recover its systems and mitigate further damage.
